affected_component: Hidden oracle acceptance pytest collection scope
invariant: Hidden acceptance may execute only the oracle's own top-level test modules. Frozen fixture data inside the oracle snapshot is data and must never be collected as tests: directory-level collection crashes on legitimately delivered tests/ directories (same-basename import mismatch) and, if fixture-embedded tests execute, they pollute the junit counts the acceptance verdict is computed from. Snapshots without a top-level test module keep the legacy directory semantics.
